name: Starter Eight
description: A simple mixed deck using recovered basic melee, ranged, flying and area-damage statistics.
limitations: Raw configuration baselines are used without displayed-level normalization.
Movement, targeting and collision follow the local reconstruction.
Fireball applies immediate area damage; projectile travel and knockback are omitted.

name: Hog 2.6 (approx.)
description: The eight-card Hog cycle composition with Hog Rider, Musketeer, Ice Golem, Ice Spirit, Skeletons, Cannon, Fireball and The Log.
limitations: The card composition is preserved; combat behavior is approximate.
Hog Rider jumping, Ice Golem's death effect and Ice Spirit's freeze are omitted.
The Log is flattened to one area hit, and spell travel and knockback are omitted.
Raw stored statistics have not been normalized to a shared displayed level.

name: Logbait (approx.)
description: Goblin Barrel and Princess pressure backed by Knight, Goblin Gang, Inferno Tower, Rocket, The Log and Ice Spirit.
limitations: Goblin Barrel directly summons three recovered barrel goblins without projectile travel.
Goblin Gang uses six primary melee goblins instead of its mixed melee/spear group.
Inferno Tower uses initial damage without its ramp, and Ice Spirit's freeze is omitted.
Princess projectile patterns, rolling Log damage and spell timing are simplified.
Raw stored statistics have not been normalized to a shared displayed level.

name: Golem Beatdown (approx.)
description: A Golem push with Night Witch, Baby Dragon, Mega Minion and Lumberjack, supported by Lightning, Tornado and Barbarian Barrel.
limitations: Golem death-spawn Golemites and Night Witch bat summons are omitted.
Lumberjack's death Rage effect is omitted.
Lightning targeting and timing are simplified; Tornado applies one stored second of damage without pulling units.
Barbarian Barrel is flattened to damage without its spawned Barbarian.
Raw stored statistics have not been normalized to a shared displayed level.
